_comment: Google Play Data Safety Form - OpenRide v1.0.0
_description: This file documents all data types collected by OpenRide for the Google Play Store Data Safety section. Use this as a reference when filling out the Data Safety form in the Google Play Console.

approximate_location.description: Approximate location is used to match riders with nearby drivers and show available rides in the area.

precise_location.description: Precise GPS location is collected during active rides only for navigation, fare calculation based on distance, and safety/dispute resolution. Drivers share precise location while online to enable ride matching.

name.description: Full name is required for account creation, identity verification, and is shared with Stripe for payment processing.

email_address.description: Email address is used for account login, notifications, governance participation, and is shared with Stripe for payment processing.

phone_number.description: Phone number is used for two-factor authentication and is shared with Twilio for ride-related SMS notifications and masked calls between riders and drivers.

address.description: We do not collect home or work addresses. Pickup and destination addresses are ride-specific and covered under location data.

user_ids.description: Internal user IDs and Stripe customer IDs are used to manage accounts and process payments.

purchase_history.description: Ride transaction history including fares, dates, and payment status. Retained for receipts, tax records, and dispute resolution.

payment_info.description: Payment card details (last 4 digits, type, expiration) are collected for display purposes. Full payment data is processed and stored by Stripe, our PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant payment processor. Bank account details for driver payouts are collected via Stripe Connect.

credit_score.description: We do not collect credit scores.

photos.description: Profile photos are optionally collected for identity verification during rides. Driver document photos (license, insurance) are collected for verification purposes.

videos.description: We do not collect video data.

contacts.description: Contact access is optional and used only for the referral feature. Contacts are read on-device and never uploaded to our servers.

app_interactions.description: We do not track in-app user interactions, screen views, or tap patterns.

in_app_search_history.description: We do not store search history beyond the current session.

installed_apps.description: We do not scan or collect information about installed apps.

device_id.description: Push notification token is collected to send ride-related notifications. Device type and OS version are collected for app compatibility and bug resolution.

advertising_id.description: We do not collect advertising identifiers. OpenRide does not serve ads and does not participate in ad networks.

other_in_app_messages.description: In-app messages between riders and drivers during active rides are temporarily stored for safety and dispute resolution purposes. Messages are deleted after 90 days.

emails.description: We do not read or collect user emails.

sms_or_mms.description: We do not read or collect SMS/MMS messages.

drivers_license.description: Driver's license number and photo are collected from driver applicants for identity verification and are shared with our background check provider for motor vehicle record checks.

health_and_fitness.description: We do not collect any health or fitness data.

voice_or_sound_recordings.description: We do not record voice calls. In-app voice calls are facilitated through Twilio but not recorded by OpenRide.

web_browsing_history.description: We do not collect web browsing history.

third_party_services.name: Twilio
third_party_services.purpose: SMS notifications and masked voice calls

third_party_services.name: Background Check Provider
third_party_services.purpose: Driver background and motor vehicle record checks

third_party_services.name: Google Maps Platform
third_party_services.purpose: Map display, geocoding, and route calculation
